turns.tutor:
Yes, we can. Our goal today is to talk about amounts: things you can count one by one, and things you cannot count.

This is very useful in daily life, for example when you shop for food or cook with a friend.

Let us start with what you already know. Think of your own kitchen. Name one thing you can count one by one, and one thing you cannot count, such as a liquid or a powder.
